I can't use Telltale's instructions as a model for Joad. Telltale's expert-review and settlement-timing instructions are that client's confidential information. In at least one Telltale matter, the client also told us not to share its strategy or work product, and the team recommended that nobody use anything from that case in another matter. Joad hasn't consented to any of this, and Telltale hasn't consented to our drawing on its instructions for a different client. If you want a model for Joad, I'd build it from Joad's own file and general practice.

**Joad's own instructions on experts**
- The client wants to review the names and credentials of all proposed testifying experts before engagement. It also asked who would speak to industry practice, and it prefers design testimony to stay focused on this axle.
- Dr. Esquivel (design and testing) and Dr. Grosvenor (standards) should not be engaged until Thorsby has consulted the client and the client has approved. Dr. Grosvenor's retention letter should be limited to the standards and their history.
- The client has not given us any pre-service report review requirement. If you want one, ask Thorsby whether Joad wants to review reports before service and how much time it needs. Any comments should go through counsel and be logged, so the exchange stays protected.
- The agreed schedule is plaintiff's reports March 8, 2024, defense reports June 14, 2024, and plaintiff's rebuttal July 8, 2024. That file is from early 2024, so confirm where the schedule stands today.

**Joad's own instructions on settlement timing**
- The memo does not recommend settlement talks now, because the sequence evidence is too uncertain. We should revisit after the joint spindle examination. If the sequence picture is favorable, a $1.2 million to $2 million range could be explored.
- Cobaltridge has pre-approved settlement up to $1.5 million. Any offer within that tier must be checked with Thorsby before it is conveyed, because the insurer will want to be involved.
- No offer above $1.5 million may be made or signaled without written board sign-off. Verbal indications from directors or officers don't count, and the client needs about three weeks to prepare a board consent. Flag this early if the upper part of the range is in play.
- Copy Perpetua Wallace on anything bearing on coverage.

I can draft a short proposal for Thorsby covering report review, expert approval, and the settlement trigger points.
